title: From structure prediction to ligand-target recognition: expanding the reach of AlphaFold in natural product research.
authors: Xu, Guangrui; Hu, Haifeng; Zhao, Weihui; Liu, Zhengxi; Wang, Ting; Liu, Rui; Liu, Song
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统总结了AlphaFold在天然产物研究中的应用，涵盖靶标结构预测、配体-靶标识别及共折叠分析，虽以天然产物为对象但核心聚焦蛋白质结构预测与相互作用建模，方法上依赖AlphaFold，对蛋白质结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: Natural products constitute a structurally diverse reservoir of bioactive molecules and remain an important source of lead compounds for drug discovery. However, the limited availability of structural information on pharmacological targets and biomolecular interactions continues to hinder mechanism elucidation and structure-guided optimization, particularly for complex natural products such as bioactive peptides, proteinaceous natural products, and natural molecular glues. Recent advances in AlphaFold have transformed structural biology by enabling high-confidence prediction of protein structures and biomolecular complexes, providing unprecedented opportunities for structure-guided natural product research. Beyond conventional structure-based virtual screening, emerging co-folding strategies have demonstrated considerable potential for improving early enrichment in natural product screening and for elucidating the binding mechanisms of complex natural products with their targets. This review summarizes recent advances in AlphaFold-assisted natural product research, including target structure prediction, hit and lead discovery, co-folding-enabled interaction analysis, mechanistic investigation of peptide- and protein-derived natural products, and the emerging potential of AlphaFold for natural molecular glue discovery. We further discuss current limitations and future directions in structure prediction and interaction modeling. Overall, AlphaFold is reshaping natural product research from lead discovery to mechanistic characterization, with particular promise for advancing macromolecular natural products and molecular glue-mediated therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 天然产物构成了结构多样的生物活性分子库，并仍是药物发现中先导化合物的重要来源。然而，药理学靶标和生物分子相互作用的结构信息有限，持续阻碍了机制阐明和结构导向优化，尤其是对于复杂天然产物，如生物活性肽、蛋白质类天然产物和天然分子胶。AlphaFold的最新进展通过实现蛋白质结构和生物分子复合物的高置信度预测，变革了结构生物学，为结构导向的天然产物研究提供了前所未有的机遇。超越传统的基于结构的虚拟筛选，新兴的共折叠策略已显示出在改善天然产物筛选早期富集和阐明复杂天然产物与其靶标结合机制方面的巨大潜力。本综述总结了AlphaFold辅助天然产物研究的最新进展，包括靶标结构预测、命中物和先导物发现、共折叠驱动的相互作用分析、肽源和蛋白源天然产物的机制研究，以及AlphaFold在天然分子胶发现中的新兴潜力。我们进一步讨论了当前结构预测和相互作用建模的局限性及未来方向。总体而言，AlphaFold正在重塑从先导发现到机制表征的天然产物研究，尤其在推进大分子天然产物和分子胶介导疗法方面展现出特别前景。
